training_speed_definition: First evaluated round with test AP >= 0.990000 * best observed test AP in the run.
late_training_definition: Mean test AP and linear AP slope over the exact final 11 communication-round values; with an 80-round run and late_rounds=11, this corresponds to rounds 70-80 inclusive.

test_set.selection_policy: Test trajectories are used only for post-hoc description of training dynamics and do not alter training, validation-based checkpoint selection, thresholds, or hyperparameters.
